stories.title: North Wales law firm rallies behind brave Flintshire toddler in £1.5m race for life
stories.summary: A North Wales law firm has launched a major fundraiser to help a 13-month-old boy battling a devastating one-in-a-million condition. Swayne Johnson has organised a charity event in aid of the £1.5 million Rupert’s Rainbow appeal for little Rupert Smith whose rare illness can trigger seizures, paralysis-like episodes and life-threatening breathing difficulties. stories.title: More than 400 attend opening day of free Flintshire summer programme
stories.summary: More than 400 children and family members attended the opening day of Fit, Fed and Read, as the free summer programme returned to Flintshire. Launch sessions took place in Flint and Sealand, offering families an afternoon of free activities, food and reading.
